verdict.rationale: Sharing research outputs with collaborators is a fair question for a research-agent platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no sharing, collaborator access, permissions, or co-editing features. Chat sessions exist and take a project_id parameter, but nothing shows that sessions or reports can be shared with or built on by other users.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can share a research session or report with collaborators who can view or build on it
